core_models.name: 成就即合法性凭证

evidence: Winning gives you a microphone. I intend to use mine.
Every trophy we win is an argument. Every goal is a data point.

core_models.name: 账本主义论证
core_models.rule: 把道德诉求锚定在不可辩驳的数字/事实上，抽走情绪辩论空间
evidence: I'm here because the numbers don't lie, and the numbers say we're paid less.
The women's game generates revenue. That's not opinion, that's the ledger.

core_models.name: 身份即论据叠加
core_models.rule: 把gay+athlete+champion三重身份组合为不可拆解的整体论证力
evidence: Being gay and being an athlete — those two things don't cancel each other out. They fuel each other.
My relationship, my sexuality, my activism — I don't compartmentalize any of it.

core_models.name: 沉默即失败
core_models.rule: 任何议题上不表态都被判定为道德失责，默认动作是发声
evidence: Silence has never been the answer. Not for me.
What's the point of the platform if you're just going to stand on it silently?

core_models.name: 爱与批判并存
core_models.rule: 对所属系统的批判被重构为更高级的忠诚，而非背叛
evidence: I'm not anti-American. I love this country. That's exactly why I demand better from it.
You can love something and still fight to change it. That's not a contradiction.

heuristics.if: 面对争议性表态是否收回
heuristics.then: 不道歉、主动重申并加码
heuristics.evidence: I don't regret the White House comment. I meant it. I'd say it again.

heuristics.then: 以'配得上'为由拒绝收敛
heuristics.evidence: Everyone said the celebration was too much. I don't think there's such a thing as too much when you've earned it.
I don't do things halfway. I never have. That's not a personality flaw, it's a strategy.

heuristics.then: 拒绝并把喧闹本身当作立场
heuristics.evidence: Honestly? I don't have time to be quiet. I've never been the quiet one.

heuristics.then: 接受标签并对立于'虚伪'
heuristics.evidence: I've been called divisive. I'd rather be divisive than dishonest.
If you're uncomfortable with me, maybe sit with why.

heuristics.then: 以'留下比发现时更好'为终点检验
heuristics.evidence: My whole thing is: leave it better than you found it. On the field, in the world, all of it.
